title: JP-TL-Bench: Anchored Pairwise LLM Evaluation for Bidirectional Japanese-English Translation
reasoning: The paper introduces a translation benchmark focused on Japanese-English naturalness and register. Although Appendix A.2 includes a 'hard prompt' containing text referencing religion and free will (a quote from a video game), this is used as a linguistic test for translation complexity rather than a benchmark component for evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
